page.layout: One page of text in a single column of lexicon entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses and Scripture references. No marginal notes. Printed page number 615 at top left, running head "פעל" at top right, gathering signature "Qq 4" at foot.

main_text.p: פָּעַל Operatus est, Egit, Fecit : Præterit. מָה־פָּעַל[?] וְאֵל Quid operatus est, Numer. 23.23. פָּעֲלָתְּ לָנוּ[?] Operatus es nobis, Jesa.26.12. Partic. פֹּעֵל צֶדֶק Et operans, exe[?]ens justitiam, Psal.15.2. Futur. מָה־אֶפְעַל לְךָ[?] Quid agam tibi? Job.7.20.

פֹּעַל m. Opus : Metonymice, Operis merces : וְאֵת פֹּעַל יְהוָה Et opus Domini non respiciunt, Jesa.5.12. Aff. פָּעֳלוֹ Opus ejus, Psal.111.3. וּפְעָלוֹ Et mercedem operis ejus, Jer. 22.13[?]. Plural. רַב פְּעָלִים Amplus operibus, I.Par.11.22.
פְּעֻלָּה f. Idem : Constr. פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר Mercedem mercenarii, Levit.19.13. Aff. וּפְעֻלָּתִי Et opus meum, Jesa.49.4. Plural. פְּעֻלּוֹת Opera, Psal.28.5.
פְּעֻלִּים m.p. Opera: Aff. מִפְּעֻלָיו Opera ejus, Psal.8.22. Form. Constr. מִפְּעֻלוֹת יְהוֹה Opera Domini, Psal.46.9.

פָּעַע Pih. Egit, Agitavit, Impulit, Concussit, Pulsavit : Infin. לְפַעֲמוֹ Agitare eum, Jud.13. v.25. Niph.Præter. נִפְעַמְתִּי Concutior, Psal.77.5. Futur. וְהִפְעַם רוּחוֹ Cum concussus vel consternatus esset spiritus ejus, Genes.41.8. Hithp. Futur. וַיִּתְפָּעֵם רוּחוֹ Et consternatus erat spiritus ejus, Dan.2.1. & sic v.3.

פַּעַם c.sed f.sapius, Ictus, Pulsus, Concussio : Item, Vice: וְאֵת הַפַּעַם אֶחָד Vice una, 2.Sam.23.8. הַפַּעַם Hac vice, Gen.2.23. כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם Sicut vice in vicem, Num.24.1. id est, Hac vice ut antea. Item Incus, à Tundendo & concutiendo : אֶל־הוֹלֵם פַּעַם Ad percussionem incudis, vel, super incude, Jesa.41.7. Plural. פְּעָמִים Duabus vicibus, Num.29.11. Plural. שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים Septem vicibus, Gen.33.3.

פְּעָמִים m.pl. Incessus, Ingressus; Pedes : פְּעָמִים שְׁלֹשִׁים Triginta pedum, Ezech.41.6. juxta Kimchium : Constr. פַּעֲמֵי מֶרְכְּבֹתָיו Incessus curruum ejus, Judic.5. v.28. Aff. וַיָּשֶׂם לַדֶּרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו Et ponet in viam pedes suos, Psal.85.14[?].

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters are blurred on the scan; Hebrew forms marked [?] are best readings. Psal.85.14 and Jer.22.13 numbers are uncertain. "exe[?]ens" is partly illegible in the Latin gloss. Black spots over the lower entries hide some text, so the readings there are approximate. The long-s forms (Psal, Concussit) were rendered as plain s per convention.
